d: In this video, Firstpost explains how India's electric car market has crossed the three-lakh sales milestone for the first time in 2026. With sales rising 66 per cent year-on-year, Tata Motors continues to dominate, accounting for nearly two out of every five electric cars sold. But Mahindra has overtaken MG Motor to secure the second spot. Meanwhile, Tesla is making its presence felt in India's luxury EV market, alongside BMW and Mercedes-Benz. From record monthly sales to growing competition, we look at what is driving India's electric vehicle boom and whether this momentum can continue.
